meta.notes: All 9 tinctures. ApothecaryChannel = 180 ticks. Movement-locked. Interrupted by unblocked damage = wasted + bleed.

tinctures.name: Basilicon Ointment
tinctures.description: Thick paste. Smells like rendered fat and rosemary. Burns going on. Heals underneath.

tinctures.name: Amniotic Purge
tinctures.effect: Removes all active debuffs. Reduces Tarnish by potency
tinctures.description: Clear fluid that tastes like salt and iron. Your body rejects everything foreign. Violently.

tinctures.name: Void Extract
tinctures.effect: Next attack deals bonus darkness damage equal to potency. Costs Clarity
tinctures.description: Black. Not dark — black. Light doesn't reflect. It doesn't pour. It moves.

tinctures.name: Quicksilver Draught
tinctures.effect: Momentum buff. Movement and attack speed increased by potency permyriad
tinctures.description: Mercury-bright. Rolls in the vial like it's looking for a way out. Tastes like a battery.

tinctures.name: Giant Phial
tinctures.effect: Size increase. Sprite scale 1.5x. Vigor +potency. Shadow-Weight +potency. Momentum -1500
tinctures.description: Thick amber syrup. Your bones ache before the growth starts. Everything gets louder.

tinctures.name: Shrink Phial
tinctures.effect: Size decrease. Sprite scale 0.6x. Momentum +potency. Shadow-Weight -potency. Vigor -1500
tinctures.description: Pale green. Smells like crushed ants. The world gets bigger. You get faster. Everything can step on you.

tinctures.name: Calcification Tincture
tinctures.effect: Defense buff. Physical defense increased by potency. Movement reduced by 1500 permyriad
tinctures.description: White powder dissolved in brine. Your skin hardens. Not armor — calcification. Temporary. Hopefully.

tinctures.name: Rorschach Inkblot
tinctures.effect: Perception. Reveals hidden geometry, enemy weaknesses, and Shadow proximity for duration. Clarity +potency
tinctures.description: Dark ink that moves in the vial. When you drink it, you see what was always there. Some of it sees you back.

tinctures.name: Philosopher's Crucible
tinctures.effect: High-risk. ALL stats boosted by potency for duration. On expiry: ALL stats REDUCED by potency for equal duration. If killed during boost: permanent -5 to all stats
tinctures.description: Gold. Actual gold, suspended in something that shouldn't be liquid. This is the Shield Rod. This is the shortcut. The price comes later.
